notes: CV dated June 2014; the three graph-only students may be later advisees, but these files cannot establish that. Student arrays cover doctoral advising roles in the CV: both contains the three principal advisees; cv_only contains 12 dissertation committee relationships, then four outside-reader relationships (Clark, Podhurst, Sherman, Brancher). These 16 are not evidence of missing principal-advisor edges; no principal doctoral advisee is CV-only. Iain Large left after the MA and is excluded. Gagne/Gagné is a spelling normalization. All nine graph works on p-1659 appear in the CV. Year 0 means unspecified, including forthcoming items; review years are not the reviewed books' dates. The Burke review is dated 2001-2 (represented as 2001). Take Note's 2012 date is inferred from its associated conference. Repeated mentions and paperback editions are not separate works. Descriptive titles identify the untitled Grafton biography and Siraisi citation. Included are Blair's two publicity articles, published 2004 Siraisi citation, and Lestringant translation. Excluded are others' reviews/publicity; unpublished projects Hidden Hands, the Catholic natural theology book, and untitled Grafton Festschrift; the HarvardX module and 2006 AHA citation without specified publication; presentations, honors, teaching, and service.
